take_homes: The agent's own review of its own work is soft by default. Use a cold reader, a fresh session with only the output, and trust my own read over its report.
Save what I learn as a rules file, then retro it after the next session so it improves each round. I can use that for non-engineers.
The same prompt gives a very different result depending on the context in front of it.
